---
name: "Tally"
description: "A calm, tactile minimalist design system for single-purpose counting and everyday utility tools."
---

## Overview

Tally embodies **Tactile Minimalism** — a quiet, distraction-free interface built around a single focal point. Designed for everyday utility, it pairs generous breathing room on soft mineral-tinted surfaces with crisp, responsive controls that feel immediate and physical. The experience is calm, legible at a glance, and strictly focused on the task at hand.

## Colors

The palette is anchored by a deep mineral teal (`#1D6A63` in light mode) on a cool, airy mist surface (`#F6FAF8`), providing high contrast without harsh pure-black-on-white glare. Tonal surface containers separate the interactive stage from the background, while semantic roles adapt cleanly between light and dark modes.

- **Primary:** Deep mineral teal for primary increment actions and active focus states.
- **Secondary:** Muted sage-slate for secondary controls such as decrementing or resetting.
- **Surface Hierarchy:** Soft neutral-cool tiers (`surface` → `surface-container-low` → `surface-container-lowest`) create gentle depth without heavy shadows.

```yaml
colors:
  light:
    primary: "#1D6A63"
    on-primary: "#E2FFFA"
    primary-container: "#A8F0E7"
    on-primary-container: "#045C56"
    secondary: "#4A6460"
    on-secondary: "#E2FFFA"
    secondary-container: "#CCE8E4"
    on-secondary-container: "#3D5653"
    tertiary: "#356579"
    on-tertiary: "#F3FAFF"
    tertiary-container: "#B7E7FF"
    on-tertiary-container: "#245669"
    error: "#A83836"
    on-error: "#FFF7F6"
    error-container: "#FA746F"
    on-error-container: "#6E0A12"
    background: "#F6FAF8"
    on-background: "#2A3433"
    surface: "#F6FAF8"
    surface-dim: "#D1DCDA"
    surface-bright: "#F6FAF8"
    surface-container-lowest: "#FFFFFF"
    surface-container-low: "#EEF5F3"
    surface-container: "#E7F0ED"
    surface-container-high: "#E1EAE8"
    surface-container-highest: "#D9E5E2"
    on-surface: "#2A3433"
    surface-variant: "#D9E5E2"
    on-surface-variant: "#56615F"
    outline: "#727D7B"
    outline-variant: "#A9B4B2"
    inverse-surface: "#0A0F0E"
    inverse-on-surface: "#999E9C"
    inverse-primary: "#B6FEF5"
    shadow: "#000000"
    scrim: "#000000"
  dark:
    primary: "#9CD1C9"
    on-primary: "#0F4843"
    primary-container: "#265B55"
    on-primary-container: "#B8EEE6"
    secondary: "#B1CCC8"
    on-secondary: "#2C4542"
    secondary-container: "#27403D"
    on-secondary-container: "#A9C5C0"
    tertiary: "#D9F2FF"
    on-tertiary: "#2E5E72"
    tertiary-container: "#B7E7FF"
    on-tertiary-container: "#245669"
    error: "#FA746F"
    on-error: "#490006"
    error-container: "#871F21"
    on-error-container: "#FF9993"
    background: "#0A0F0E"
    on-background: "#DCE8E5"
    surface: "#0A0F0E"
    surface-dim: "#0A0F0E"
    surface-bright: "#242E2D"
    surface-container-lowest: "#000000"
    surface-container-low: "#0E1514"
    surface-container: "#131B1A"
    surface-container-high: "#192120"
    surface-container-highest: "#1D2826"
    on-surface: "#DCE8E5"
    surface-variant: "#1D2826"
    on-surface-variant: "#A2ADAB"
    outline: "#6D7876"
    outline-variant: "#3F4A48"
    inverse-surface: "#F6FAF8"
    inverse-on-surface: "#515655"
    inverse-primary: "#346762"
    shadow: "#000000"
    scrim: "#000000"
```

## Typography

The type system pairs **Wix Madefor Display** for crisp geometric headings and large count readouts, **Instrument Sans** for clean UI labels and body copy, and **Spline Sans Mono** for tabular numeric precision. All numeric readouts use `tabular-nums` so digits never jitter when incrementing or decrementing.

```yaml
typography:
  display-lg:
    fontFamily: "Wix Madefor Display"
    fontSize: 72px
    fontWeight: 700
    lineHeight: 80px
    letterSpacing: -2px
  display-lg-mobile:
    fontFamily: "Wix Madefor Display"
    fontSize: 32px
    fontWeight: 700
    lineHeight: 38px
    letterSpacing: -0.75px
  headline-lg:
    fontFamily: "Wix Madefor Display"
    fontSize: 32px
    fontWeight: 600
    lineHeight: 40px
    letterSpacing: -0.5px
  headline-lg-mobile:
    fontFamily: "Wix Madefor Display"
    fontSize: 24px
    fontWeight: 600
    lineHeight: 30px
    letterSpacing: -0.25px
  title-md:
    fontFamily: "Instrument Sans"
    fontSize: 18px
    fontWeight: 600
    lineHeight: 24px
    letterSpacing: 0px
  body-md:
    fontFamily: "Instrument Sans"
    fontSize: 15px
    fontWeight: 400
    lineHeight: 22px
    letterSpacing: 0px
  label-lg:
    fontFamily: "Instrument Sans"
    fontSize: 15px
    fontWeight: 600
    lineHeight: 20px
    letterSpacing: 0.1px
  label-sm:
    fontFamily: "Instrument Sans"
    fontSize: 12px
    fontWeight: 500
    lineHeight: 16px
    letterSpacing: 0.2px
  mono-lg:
    fontFamily: "Spline Sans Mono"
    fontSize: 14px
    fontWeight: 500
    lineHeight: 20px
    letterSpacing: 0px
```

## Layout & Spacing

A single-column centered layout keeps the primary counter stage anchored in the middle of the viewport on both mobile (`390px`) and desktop (`1280px`), bounded by generous margins and built on an 8px spacing scale (with a 4px half-step for tight icon-label pairs).

```yaml
spacing:
  gutter-xs: 4px
  gutter-sm: 8px
  gutter-md: 16px
  gutter-lg: 24px
  gutter-xl: 32px
  section: 48px
  page-margin: 24px
```

## Elevation & Depth

Hierarchy relies on **tonal layers** and **low-contrast outlines** rather than heavy drop shadows. The primary counter card rests on `surface-container-lowest` (`#FFFFFF` in light mode) framed by a subtle `1px` `outline-variant` border over the `surface` canvas. Interactive buttons use solid tonal fills (`primary` or `secondary-container`) with subtle scale feedback on press.

## Shapes

Generous, friendly corner radii soften the utility aesthetic: `24px` (`xl`) for the main counter stage card, `16px` (`lg`) for tactile action buttons, and `full` (`9999px`) for compact pill actions like reset.

```yaml
rounded:
  sm: 4px
  DEFAULT: 8px
  md: 12px
  lg: 16px
  xl: 24px
  full: 9999px
```

## Motion & Micro-interaction

Motion is crisp, immediate, and restrained. Button presses and count updates respond within 100ms using `transform` and color transitions only, honoring `prefers-reduced-motion`. Nothing loops or animates purely for decoration.

```yaml
motion:
  state-change:
    duration: 100ms
    delay: 0ms
    timingFunction: ease-out
  surface-enter:
    duration: 200ms
    delay: 0ms
    timingFunction: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)
  surface-exit:
    duration: 150ms
    delay: 0ms
    timingFunction: cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 1, 1)
```

## Voice & Content Strategy

Copy is **concise, direct, and calm**—never wordy or playful to the point of clutter. Use sentence case for all headings and button labels. Actions use clear verbs or unmistakable symbols (`Increment`, `Decrement`, `Reset`). All numeric values use tabular figures (`tabular-nums`) with no unnecessary decimals or units.

## Components

Component implementations live as individual HTML sticker sheet files in
`components/`. Each file contains the canonical, styled HTML components with
`<!-- COMPONENT: name -->` comment markers. Read each file before use.

- **Button** → `@components/button.html` — `button-primary`, `button-icon`, `button-with-icon`
- **Card** → `@components/card.html` — `card-elevated`, `card-action`, `card-interactive`, `card-interactive-2`
- **Typography** → `@components/typography.html` — `typography-display`, `typography-body`, `typography-label`
